news.headline: One Stop Systems Reports Q3 2026 Results
news.summary: Continuing-operations revenue rose about 36% to $12.6M, with year-to-date book-to-bill of 1.46. Full-year growth guidance was raised to about 40%.

news.headline: One Stop Systems Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news.summary: Management lifted the outlook, guiding gross margin of 40-42% and adj. EBITDA of $0.5-1M, with Q3 absorbing bad-debt and legal-settlement costs.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results
catalysts.detail: Expected around early 2027; date not announced.

pulse: OSS is growing again, with Q3 revenue up about 36% and guidance raised to roughly 40% growth. Margins are lower and a one-off settlement and bad debt weighed on the quarter.
